'''2001 EdgeCon Open''' was a Star Wars CCG open on 2001. It is known from Tim Guzman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3011">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-02-edgecon-a-late-report-from-timd3011/ edgecon-a-late-report-from-tim], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 2 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-02-edgecon-a-late-report-from-timd3011/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
